Name: Small Beach Farm
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Adds a pocket beach farm type suitable for slower or challenge runs, and lets you catch both river and ocean fish.
Description:
**Small Beach Farm** replaces the beach farm (configurable) with a fertile pocket beach suitable for slower or challenge runs, and lets you catch both river and ocean fish. You can optionally enable islands and beach sounds.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/farm.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)

1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the mod folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)

Just load a save with the beach farm, and you'll see the new map!

### Highlights
* The beach is fertile, so you can plant crops in the grass and sand too:  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/tilled.png)
* You can catch riverlands fish in the river and ocean fish in the ocean (for both fishing and crab pots):  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/fish-areas.png)
* The exit to Marnie's ranch is on the right:  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/exits.png)
* The beach includes a functional campfire you can use (pairs well with [Campfire Cooking](https://mods.smapi.io/#Campfire_Cooking)):  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/campfire.gif)

### Tips
* Fish quality depends on how far from shore the bobber is. The bottom-left area of the river mouth is wide enough to catch max-quality river fish:  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/best-river-spot.png)
* If you need more space, download the optional `config.json` to add some islands:  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/screenshots/farm-islands.png)
* If you use [Automate](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063), you can connect chests to crab pots all along the beach:  
  ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/SmallBeachFarm/docs/automate-crabpots.png)
* If you load an existing save and have things in the water due to the smaller map, see [Saves#Change farm type](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Saves#Change_farm_type) for some suggested fixes (skip the part about editing the save file).

### Configure
You can edit the settings in-game or by editing the `config.json`; see [_configure_ in the readme](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/SmallBeachFarm#configure) for more info.

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, and Windows;
  * single-player and multiplayer.
* Not compatible with other mods which replace the same farm map.

It should work with most map recolors. To add support for a new recolor, see [details in the readme](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/develop/SmallBeachFarm#can-i-add-compatibility-with-a-recolor-mod).

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
